objective: Test whether retaining distinct early/late causal models and updating a public-data belief after first-stage consequences can preserve prior-world reward without losing shifted-world reward.
research_classification: Synthetic retrospective development on previously consumed CKAD20 source, no new environment access authority; native learned checkpoint remains byte-identical and stored legacy retained.
training_selection: Extract only first64 previously observed 'train-0' active intervention episodes and last96 observed 'train-2' active intervention episodes from the same 224-event checkpoint; validate every event ID from frozen source, preserve chronological identity, no evaluator label/family/regime in learner.
model: Two separate fully fitted conventional Beta(1,1) contingency tables, same public initial view projection as the native trained state, conditional transition P(s2|view,x1) and terminal P(y|view,x1,s2,x2) with pooled fallback for absent context. Fixed equal 1/2 early/late prior.
intervention_plan: At stage1 enumerate both first actions and maximize mixture expected delayed reward; at stage2 after actual public s2 update early-vs-late model probabilities by Bayes using transition likelihood, then choose second action maximizing posterior mixture terminal success. No lookahead at hidden episode label, future state, reward or counterfactual.
frozen_arms: two_timescale_dynamic: equal-prior early/late with consequence-conditioned Bayesian update on observed s2
two_timescale_static: same early/late tables and prior but no s2 belief update
early_only: early retained phase0 evidence alone
late_only: last96 shifted phase evidence alone
full_beta: exact conventional fully fitted entire 224 public episodes
trailing64_mle: previously-qualified trailing64 conventional fully trained MLE
test_protocol: For each seed101/202/303 evaluate 96 previously-consumed held deterministic source draws in each eval-0 invariant, eval-1 context_switch regime0, eval-2 context_switch regime1, and eval-3 terminal_switch regime1. Each arm actually executes its own selected two-stage actions on identical exogenous draws, with final reward revealed only after second action. No held adaptation or observations added to the training tables. Report per-seed/per-cohort reward and per-action trace digest.
validation: All source bytes and checkpoints exact-pin. Complete checkpoint restored with original native APIs. Verify first64 and last96 active event IDs, collision/missing/duplicate denial, test no original source reset/do, no hidden source fields in policies, fixed deterministic cross-platform stable output. Independently recompute mixture plan with a second conventional enumeration and ensure all public view/action readouts tie; reverse early/late labels must leave dynamic/readout invariant. Existing synthetic family is not unfamiliar/first-use.

frozen_success.development: After phase3: eval-0 dynamic reward>=233/288 (within 5pp of phase1 native 247/288) AND eval-2 dynamic reward>=245/288 (at least 2pp above trailing64 MLE 239/288), AND dynamic policy eval0/2 each exceeds static mixture by >=6/288.
frozen_success.engineering: No checkpoint/source mutation, exact input pins, negative controls, deterministic stable digest, independent formula parity, mandatory full exact candidate root+NKR05 Linux/Windows and atlas independent audits.
frozen_success.scientific: No scientific superiority: both tables are conventional fully trained Bayes and source previously consumed, three seeds. scientific_pass=false.

authority: Isolated opt-in development on exact CKAD20 accepted draft evidence, no controller/owner/scheduler changes, no new PR, merge, accepted-main mutation, real source first-use, promotion or deployment. Do not change frozen criteria after scores.
